title: Volcanoes
text: A volcano is a special mountain. Inside the Earth it is very, very hot. There is rock that is liquid. Its name is magma. When the magma comes out of a volcano, its name is lava.
Lava is red and orange. It is very hot: more than one thousand degrees! It moves slowly down the mountain and it burns everything.
Some volcanoes are active. They can erupt. When a volcano erupts, there is fire, smoke and ash. Other volcanoes are asleep. Their last eruption was a long time ago.
There are volcanoes on every continent, also in Antarctica. In Spain there are volcanoes in the Canary Islands. In 2021 the volcano of La Palma erupted for almost three months.
Volcanoes are dangerous, but they are also useful. Their ash makes the land very good for plants. And their heat can make electricity. Volcanoes are the fire of our planet.
q: What is the name of magma when it comes out?
What happens when a volcano erupts?
There is fire, smoke and ash
Where are there volcanoes in Spain?
Their ash is good for plants

grammar.title: Grammar: possessive adjectives
grammar.rule: Possessive adjectives say who something belongs to. They go before the noun.
items: The magma comes out. ___ name is lava.
Volcanoes are useful. ___ ash is good for plants.
We live on Earth. It is ___ planet.
I like volcanoes. ___ favorite is Teide.
Maria lives in La Palma. ___ house is near the volcano.

es.title: Los volcanes
es.grammar: Gramática: los adjetivos posesivos dicen de quién es algo. Van delante del nombre.
